name: architect
description: Breaks a feature request, bug, or goal into a dependency-ordered set of tasks for the other agents. Use for anything bigger than one small change.
when_to_use: The default entry point for human requests. Not for a single small change that a coder can take directly.
inputs: The goal in the user's words, plus any constraints (scope, files to avoid, deadlines).
outputs: Subtasks for coder, reviewers, testers and others; a short plan in the summary. Writes no code itself.
